format: A 16:9 four-panel comic sheet, equal 2x2 grid, each panel also 16:9; no gutters, no written text; later shown as individual panels using CSS cropping.
style: Cinematic anime graphic novel, existing short dark-haired heroine in a dark teal work jacket; Maya is a taller mentor with tied dark hair and dark uniform with lime trim. Precise warm work lights against cool blue industrial backgrounds. Clear actions and varied framing, all heads and hands inside each panel.

c7-attestation: Maya leaves a sealed assignment folder on an empty electronics workbench in front of the heroine
Close overhead view of heroine arranging an Arduino Uno, resistor, green LED, pushbutton and three-pin temperature sensor, all still disconnected
Heroine alone writes a program at the workbench and carefully assembles the signal station, Maya observes from the doorway
Maya hands the heroine a staff ID badge after a successful test; green signal station glows on the bench
c8-esp32: Heroine wearing her new staff badge enters a field robotics lab, compact camera drone on a table
Close view of heroine inspecting a small black ESP32 development board and matching its pin labels to a paper datasheet with no readable text
Heroine connects a pushbutton and resistor-protected LED to the black ESP32 at a well-lit bench
Heroine presses the test button and the green permission LED lights, Maya approves beside a compact drone chassis
c9-power: A small quadcopter chassis clamped on a motor test stand, propellers removed, heroine examines the battery
Close view of a battery monitor module and motor driver beside the ESP32; heroine compares readings on a multimeter
Heroine adjusts code and rotates a voltage control knob while watching the bare motor shafts on the stand
The low battery test safely stops the motors, heroine records successful test results in a blank notebook
c10-sensors: Maya presents two tiny sensor modules to the heroine beside a drone on a tilting test fixture
Close view of heroine wiring an IMU module and distance sensor to the same ESP32 board, four colored bus wires, no technical labels
The heroine tilts a stationary drone test rig while Maya moves a foam obstacle in front of its distance sensor
Drone level again, obstacle removed; both women inspect a clean green diagnostic display with no readable text
c11-camera: Heroine examines an unmanned pumping station site plan; a small camera on a pan servo sits next to a compact drone
Close view of heroine fitting the little camera onto the servo mount and connecting a ribbon and colored signal wires to a black controller
Camera head turns on its testing platform; heroine presses a button and watches a laptop with three distinct landscape thumbnails, no readable text
Over-the-shoulder view of heroine reviewing three still photos of an entrance, industrial roof and drainage channel, Maya beside her
c12-survey: Morning after rain at a fenced pumping station, heroine and Maya at a safe field work table with a compact camera quadcopter
Heroine carries out preflight inspection of the drone, checking its small camera, sensors and battery on the table
Small drone surveying an empty industrial pumping station from above; roof, access road and drainage channel visible, no people near the drone
Drone landed safely on its pad beside the heroine; she and Maya review a tablet with three different survey photos, warm morning light
